title: New York Congressman Proposes Bill to Protect Video Game Ownership
excerpt: Representative Ritchie Torres plans to introduce legislation urging the FTC to establish rules ensuring consumers can keep playing purchased video games.
body_html:
A new bill is being introduced in Congress aimed at safeguarding video game ownership for consumers. Representative Ritchie Torres is planning to put forward legislation that would prompt the Federal Trade Commission to create regulations.

The proposed rules are designed to ensure that players maintain the ability to play the video games they have purchased.
